look_here_first: Start with the cut or lobed leaves and nocturnal yellow flowers. Cutleaf evening primrose is a low annual or short-lived perennial with alternate leaves that range from toothed to deeply cut-lobed, and 4-petaled yellow flowers that open around sunset.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays — Natural Purola flora lists O. laciniata. Travis — UT Plant Resources Center Onagraceae herbarium index includes O. laciniata. Williamson — dedicated county treatment documents O. laciniata.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Exact county evidence; reconciled historical synonyms only.

best_field_traits: annual or short-lived perennial from taproot
leaves variable from dentate to distinctly cut-lobed
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Unlike O. capillifolia, the leaves are much broader and commonly cut-lobed. Unlike the gaura-like species, flowers are radially symmetric and yellow rather than white/pink and strongly zygomorphic.
